topic: Getting an Estimate for a Repair

script.title: THE REPAIR ESTIMATE
script.story_hook: A laptop dies the night before a big deadline.
script.intro_zh: 筆電在大截止日前的一晚突然罷工。
script.welcome_en: Hi friends, glad you're here! Today we're getting a repair estimate.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，朋友們，很高興你們在這裡！今天我們來練習拿到維修報價。
script.outro: That's all for today! Listen once more soon.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！記得再聽一遍喔。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each line out loud now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們大聲地，一句一句跟讀。

script.char_b_description: a focused man in his thirties with short curly dark hair and safety goggles pushed up on his forehead, wearing a navy work apron over a gray t-shirt, turning a small screwdriver in his hand

This episode walks you through the whole exchange: describing the problem, requesting an estimate first, understanding the parts-plus-labor split, and locking in a firm price. 18 lines of natural American English with IPA and translations, plus a repeat-after-me section so the money questions come out smoothly.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🔧維修報價英文｜描述故障・訂購零件・工資拆分｜聽完就會問報價｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
早上要交報告，筆電卻突然開不了機？
送到維修店，怎麼開口先問價位？

這一集帶大家走進街角的筆電維修店，跟著一早抱著筆電衝出門的顧客，從描述故障開始，練習要求報價、聽懂零件訂購與工資拆分，最後拿到明天的確定總價。

你會聽到：
🔧 描述與詢問：例如「My laptop won't start, can you take a look?」、「Could I get an estimate before you fix it?」。
📦 零件與工時：例如「The part is around ninety, but it's on order.」、「Labor is sixty, flat, including the check-up.」。
💬 確認總價：例如「So one fifty total, if nothing else is broken?」、「Can I text you a firm price by tomorrow?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把關於錢的問句都問得從容。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次送修東西，帶著這一整袋句型進門吧！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, my laptop won't start, can you take a look?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ maɪ ˈlæptɑp woʊnt stɑrt kæn ju teɪk ə lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我的筆電開不了機，可以幫忙看看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. Did you drop it, or spill anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ dɪdʒu drɑp ɪt ɔr spɪl əˈnɪθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好啊。它有摔過，或是打翻過水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just yesterday it was fine, today, totally dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈjɛstərˌdeɪ ɪt wəz faɪn təˈdeɪ ˈtoʊtli dɛd/
dialogue.zh: 昨天還好好正常，今天就完全沒反應了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see. These things happen, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ siː ðiz θɪŋz ˈhæpən doʊnt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 了解了。這種事常有的，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, could I get an estimate before you fix it?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kʊd aɪ ɡɛt ən ˈɛstəmət bɪˈfɔr ju fɪks ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 所以，修之前可以先給我一個報價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. The power board likely needs a swap.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv ˈkɔrs ðə ˈpaʊər bɔrd ˈlaɪkli nidz ə swæp/
dialogue.zh: 當然。看起來是電源板需要整片更換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, and roughly how much would that cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ænd ˈrʌfli haʊ mʌtʃ wʊd ðæt kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 好，那大約會是多少錢呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The part is around ninety, but it's on order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑrt ɪz əˈraʊnd ˈnɪnti bət ɪts ɑn ˈɔrdər/
dialogue.zh: 零件大概九十美元，不過目前要訂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On order? How long would that take then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ˈɔrdər haʊ lɔŋ wʊd ðæt teɪk ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 要訂？那大約要等多久呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three days maybe, it's coming from overseas.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri deɪz ˈmeɪbi ɪts ˈkʌmɪŋ frʌm ˌoʊvərˈsiz/
dialogue.zh: 可能三天吧，它要從海外寄過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, and what about the labor cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ænd wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈleɪbər kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那工資部分怎麼算呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Labor is sixty, flat, including the check-up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪbər ɪz ˈsɪksti flæt ɪnˈklʊdɪŋ ðə ˈtʃɛkˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 工資固定六十，包含檢測費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So one fifty total, if nothing else is broken?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌn ˈfɪfti ˈtoʊtəl ɪf ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls ɪz ˈbroʊkən/
dialogue.zh: 那就是一共一百五，前提是沒有別的地方壞掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. I'll give it a second look first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli aɪl ɡɪv ɪt ə ˈsɛkənd lʊk fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。我會先仔細檢查一遍再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do. Then you'll know the real total?
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz duː ðɛn jul noʊ ðə ril ˈtoʊtəl/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了。這樣你就能報出真正的總價了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. Can I text you a firm price by tomorrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt kæn aɪ tɛkst ju ə fɜrm praɪs baɪ təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好。明天我可以傳簡訊給你確定價格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works. My number's on the repair ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜrks maɪ ˈnʌmbərz ɑn ðə rɪˈpɛr ˈtɪkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以啊。我的電話在維修單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll be in touch. Thanks for stopping by!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪl bi ɪn tʌtʃ θæŋks fər ˈstɑpɪŋ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 完美，我會聯絡你。謝謝你特地跑這一趟！
